owner_disposition.instruction: Great! So I think that we should go with recommendation as of now and continue till completion with our plan for cargo publication readiness (remember to update tracking issue status as you progress!)
owner_disposition.basis: Authorized source inspection and traced successful reference paths, independent technical agent review, exact unchanged production errors, and controlled diagnostic inputs documented in authorized_source_analysis. Acceptance is an owner engineering disposition of the observed strict rejections, not an assertion that the vectors were intended as negative tests.

authorized_source_analysis.authorization: Owner explicitly requested local reference implementation analysis; this extends the earlier execution-only consent to local source inspection, not code copying into the project, derivation, redistribution, protected standards processing or normative certification.
authorized_source_analysis.method: Original source inspection plus GDB observations from a separate g++ -g -O0 build; no original reference source changes. The debug executable still matches all nine unchanged pages for the seven cases and crashes on the unchanged first-party control.
authorized_source_analysis.tt1_codebook: Jbig2DEC.cpp SymbolID_Create (214-259) folds run-code prefix length and value into the symbol-ID code rather than using a decoded literal as its length. GDB observes lengths [2,2,1] and codes [2,3,0] for TT1, versus production literal lengths [1,1,0]. For the unchanged first-party four-symbol control, GDB observes [3,3,3,3] where production uses literal [2,2,2,2]. This explains why adding one happens to match TT1 but changes the existing valid input's wire interpretation.
authorized_source_analysis.tt1_termination: TextRegionDec_Huff_Kernel (933-1005) does read the final SubsequentS OOB. GDB observes it after exactly five placements, before the declared payload end. A new offset-only falsification candidate matches all three TT1 pages with the production final-OOB behavior unchanged, and still rejects the unchanged first-party input with InvalidCode. Count-based stopping is not needed to explain TT1 and is not a correction.
authorized_source_analysis.minimal_tt1_input_control: Changing only the two run-code-table metadata bytes at file offsets 155 and 156 makes the unchanged coded bits declare literal lengths [2,2,1]. Unmodified Rust and jbig2dec both then reproduce all three unchanged expected pages with exit 0 and no stderr. The original stream is untouched; this diagnostic copy is not counted as an official-case pass.
authorized_source_analysis.tt2_bitmap_extent: SymbolDictionarySegmentDec (841-858) uses the bitmap-size value as a nonzero switch, not a byte bound, and decodes each symbol separately. GDB observes declared size 1 with an 8-byte 5x8 bitmap at offsets 68..76; the next height class decodes separate 6x6 bitmaps of 6 and 8 bytes despite the same declared size 1. Jbig2ENC.cpp (470-478) writes the configured value before per-symbol MMR encoding instead of deriving the collective byte count.
authorized_source_analysis.arithmetic_exports: Jbig2ENC.cpp (434-435 and 514-515) writes two zero export integers. SymbolDictionarySegmentDec (814-815 and 925-926) reads two integers but does not apply or validate their runs. GDB observes [0,0] for all five arithmetic failure cases, including both TT5 dictionaries. Two zero runs do not cover the declared candidates; production continues validating runs and eventually reports a negative run.
authorized_source_analysis.dictionary_references: SegmentDecode (518-534) passes accumulated file/page symbols into text decoding instead of selecting the referred dictionaries' exports. GDB observes zero referred segments but three available symbols for TT2/TT3/TT4/TT5/TT7 and two for TT6. This explains the missing-reference failure exposed by earlier export-skipping probes; skipping exports would not be a complete correction.
authorized_source_analysis.tt3_encoder_control: Re-encode the original TT3 sample using the unchanged reference source. Both diagnostic variants receive identical explicit dictionary-reference, retention and page-combination-override header corrections. The ordinary encoder's [0,0] export pair still gives Rust's negative-export-run error. Overriding only the second export argument to the declared count 3 in GDB yields an exact unchanged expected page in unmodified Rust. This isolates an encoder parameter defect; it is a re-encoded diagnostic, not a pass of the archived official stream.
authorized_source_analysis.new_first_party_regressions: Raw literal lengths 0..31 at five run-code prefix widths; literal zero excludes a symbol; a nonblank four-ID two-bit fixture with literal pixels in sequential and random-access organizations. All three new tests fail under the isolated literal-plus-one mutant and pass after restoration.
authorized_source_analysis.fresh_native_validation: MSRV 1.88: 514 library/integration tests and one doctest pass, 14 existing tests ignored; formatting and all-target Clippy with warnings denied pass. The rebuilt normal decoder reproduces the byte-identical accepted ten-case result: 2 pass, 7 pending, 1 unsupported, exit 1.

authorized_reference_followup.execution_authorization: Explicit owner authorization at 2026-11-01T21:37:03.245+00:00 for local build/run as a black box; no implementation inspection, derivation, redistribution, protected standards processing or normative approval.
authorized_reference_followup.original_seven_cases: All seven decode with exit 0; all nine final pages equal the unchanged official bitmap normalizer. Isolated renamed encoded-only input also matches, without sibling expected BMPs.
authorized_reference_followup.negative_controls: Reference pixels for TT3 do not change when its actual declared export-count field changes from 3 to 0, 1 or 2. Removing its dictionary, zeroing arithmetic data or zeroing text data rejects or crashes instead. Adding an explicit dictionary reference preserves the reference result. These are black-box observations, not proof of normative invalidity.
authorized_reference_followup.general_oracle_boundary: The unchanged first-party standard-Huffman fixture accepted with exact literal pixels by the production Rust decoder and jbig2dec crashes this reference with signal 11.
authorized_reference_followup.rejected_candidate: Literal symbol-length plus-one with Huffman-only final-instance stopping makes all three TT1 pages exact, but rejects that same unchanged valid first-party fixture with InvalidCode. Independent technical review identifies a global wire-contract change, not a validated general correction. No such change is shipped.
authorized_reference_followup.arithmetic_boundary: All three TT3 glyphs exactly match the reference's original Sym000/001/002 bitmap inputs before export decoding. This does not establish pre-export arithmetic-register/context equivalence. Reset, padded-width, scalar-routing and terminal-marker hypotheses did not validate a correction and were restored.
authorized_reference_followup.local_raw_evidence: Raw reference outputs and controls remain under ignored target/official-conformance; no restricted assets are committed.
